reference_title: Design and Construction of Mechanically Stabilized Earth Walls and Reinforced Soil Slopes – Volume II

sections.title: Steel Soil Reinforcements
sections.body:
[p. C-1] [Linear Strip Reinforcements, typed in from p. C-1, row by row:]
Type | Dimensions | Fy/Fu | Vertical Spacing | Horizontal Spacing
Steel Strips (ribbed) | 5/32 in. thick by 2 in. wide (4 mm thick by 50 mm wide) | 65/75 ksi (450/520 MPa) | 30 in. (750 mm) | Varies, but typically 12 to 30in, (300 to 750 mm)

[Welded Wire, typed in from p. C-1, row by row:]
Wire Designation | Wire Area (in²) | Wire Diameter (in.) | Wire Area (mm²) | Wire Diameter (mm)
W3.5 | 0.035 | 0.211 | 22.6 | 5.4
W4 | 0.040 | 0.226 | 25.8 | 5.7
W4.5* | 0.045 | 0.239 | 29.0 | 6.0
W5 | 0.050 | 0.252 | 32.3 | 6.4
W7 | 0.070 | 0.298 | 45.2 | 7.6
W9.5 | 0.095 | 0.348 | 61.3 | 8.8
W11 | 0.110 | 0.374 | 71.0 | 9.5
W12 | 0.120 | 0.391 | 77.4 | 9.9
W14 | 0.140 | 0.422 | 90.3 | 10.7
W16 | 0.160 | 0.451 | 103 | 11.5
W20 | 0.200 | 0.505 | 129 | 12.8
*Typical min. size for permanent walls
Fy/Fu: 65/80 ksi (450/550 MPa)
Longitudinal Wire Spacing: Typically 6 in. (150 mm)
Transverse Wire Spacing: Typically varies 9 to 24 in. (230 to 600 mm)
Mat Spacing: For welded wire faced walls, vertically 12, 18 or 24 in. (300, 450, or 600 mm) and continuous horizontally. For precast concrete faced walls, vertically 24 to 30 in. (600 to 750 mm), horizontally 3.6 to 4 ft. (1.1 to 1.2 m) wide mats spaced at 6.2 ft (1.9 m) center-to-center or continuous
[Note on the table: W4.5's diameter of 0.239 in. is 6.07 mm; printed 6.0. The other metric cells are the inch cells converted.]

[Bar Mats, typed in from p. C-1, row by row:]
Wire Designation | Wire Area (in²) | Wire Diameter (in.) | Wire Area (mm²) | Wire Diameter (mm)
W8 | 0.080 | 0.319 | 51.6 | 8.1
W11 | 0.110 | 0.374 | 71.0 | 9.5
W15 | 0.150 | 0.437 | 96.8 | 11.1
W20 | 0.200 | 0.505 | 129 | 12.8
Fy/Fu: 65/75 ksi (450/520 MPa)
Longitudinal Wire Spacing: Typically 6 in. (150 mm) with 4 to 7 longitudinal bars per mat
Transverse Wire Spacing: Typically varies 6 to 24 in. (150 to 600 mm)
Mat Spacing: (the label is printed twice) Typically 30 in. (750 mm) vertically and 5 ft (1.5 m) center-to-center horizontally

Specific wall manufacturers may be able to provide a much wider range of reinforcement configurations depending on the design needs.
sections.applicability: FHWA-NHI-10-025 (Volume II), Appendix C (Steel Soil Reinforcements), printed p. C-1. The contents give the title as "Typical Dimensions of Steel Reinforcements"; p. C-2 is blank.
